releaseNotes:
v4.8.1 — Spotify-Style Player Upgrades & Real-Time Search Suggester:
• Reworked the music player UI into an elegant scrollable panel
• Added interactive Lyrics Preview card with beautiful gradients and quick zoom
• Added About the Artist profiles card with Follower stats, quick Follow/Unfollow toggle, and artist page navigation
• Added Spotify-style related recommendation lists ('More Songs Like This' and 'More From Artist') right below the player
• Upgraded search suggestions with real-time matching 'Top Results' displayed directly under suggestions while typing
• Offloaded PoToken generation process on startup to IO thread to prevent UI lockups
